استلمتم (form VIII)
# اِسْتَلَمْتُمْ (istalamtum) /is.ta.lam.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَلَمَ (istalama)
# اُسْتُلِمْتُمْ (ustulimtum) /us.tu.lim.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَلَمَ (istalama)
